methods.B4: Expert-core plus exploration shell plus unmodified BaCO

compile_cost_guard.policy: exclude only predicted-fallback vector schedules whose tile expansion estimate exceeds the bound

optimized_dynamic_baseline.implementation: dynamic MLIR scf tiling with vector<8xf32> FMA and scalar N-tail cleanup

claim_boundary: Single-thread row-major f32 results on one x86-64 AVX2/FMA host. Tuning trajectories are offline BaCO replays over a frozen corpus of real compiled-and-executed candidates. Confidence intervals resample workloads or seeds, not machines. Cross-host and additional-dtype performance generalization are outside this package.
